deals.counterparty: Existing shareholders of Ellora Solutions Private Limited

operating_notes.text: Acquired entity Ellora Solutions operates in consultancy services to support real estate and infrastructure consultancy expansion.

events.lender: Aditya Birla Finance Limited and SMFG India Credit Co Ltd

timeline.summary: Choice International Limited announces Q4 & FY26 earnings conference call on April 24, 2026, at 04:00 PM IST with Mr. Arun Poddar and Mr. Ayush Sharma.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹306.71 Cr (+21.2% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹60.31 Cr.
Choice International reported full conversion of ₹694 Cr share warrants and complete fund utilization in the monitoring agency report for Q4 FY26.
NCLT Mumbai Bench approves Scheme of Amalgamation merging step-down subsidiary Choice Wealth Private Limited into Arete Capital Service Private Limited.
Choice International agreed to acquire 100% of Ellora Solutions Private Limited for ₹11.60 lakh.
Choice International completed the ₹900 Cr strategic investment by NH Investment & Securities in its subsidiary CEBPL on October 27, 2026.
